definition: Select 250 satisfiable 91-clause formulas after excluding the ten training formulas, pair each formula with one satisfying assignment and one one-bit-flip violating assignment, and cyclically repeat its existing clause sequence to exactly 100 clauses.
shift_property: rule-preserving clause-count support shift from 91 training clauses to 100 clauses with duplicated-evidence multiplicity

source_metadata.assignment_pairing: solver satisfying assignment and one-bit-flip violating assignment
